summary: First-run testing of StreamClip AI MVP (Twitch clip curation). 13/13 backend pytest cases pass against public URL. Frontend loads with demo seed, all key data-testids present, channel filtering, hype-moment filter, clips-per-day persistence, settings dialog, caption editor and real GPT-5.4 AI regeneration all functional. Twitch not configured (expected).
critical_code_review_comments: server.py: startup handler starts auto_sync_loop as background task; fine but no graceful cancellation on shutdown.
server.py: model uses `int | None = None` etc. requires Python 3.10+; ok since env is 3.11.
AI generation is called inline in POST /clips/{id}/generate with no timeout guard beyond the LLM lib; consider a request-level timeout wrapper if AI hangs.
auto_sync_loop is a single-instance background loop with no leader election - fine for single pod, would double-fire if replicas>1.
No auth on any /api endpoint (as designed for MVP) - anyone with the URL can seed/delete data. Acceptable for MVP demo, but note for production.
seed_data_creation: POST /api/demo/seed creates 3 demo channels (xqc, kaicenat, pokimane) each with 6 clips; test suite also cleaned up one demo channel via cascade delete test and reseeds happen idempotently.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Backend test file is at /app/backend/tests/backend_test.py using pytest+requests against REACT_APP_BACKEND_URL. The `test_zz_delete_clip_and_channel` deletes the last demo channel; re-run POST /api/demo/seed before frontend testing. Real GPT-5.4 call (test_regenerate_clip_ai) takes ~10-15s. Twitch endpoints requiring credentials should still return 400 with clear messages - do not treat as failure.
